findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Gate - The configured full test suite will fail after this setting changes.
Case: normal use - running the full suite or scheduled full-suite check.
`tests/test_fix_the_owner_moved_this_repo_s_workers_from.py:48` reads this file and asserts that `workers` is `claude`. `tests/test_source_split_workers.py:13` also reads this file but expects a Claude call and no Codex turn. Both expectations conflict with the new setting; update the existing tests to exercise the Codex route.
findings.title: Gate: source-worker tests still require Claude

findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Functional - User-facing source tasks lose their configured design effort.
Case: normal use - starting a User-facing story task in Forge's own repo.
With `repo = "forge-source"` and the default `tools = "both"`, `src/forge/repo.py:813` treats a User-facing row as design work only when workers are `claude` or `split`. This change therefore sends the task through `[models.build.codex]` at low effort instead of `[models.design.codex]` at high effort, contrary to the documented Codex routing at `src/forge/templates/skill.md:1930`.
Adds work: preserve Codex design routing for source tasks; F 2 x H 2 = 4; 2 x C = 2
findings.title: Keep design routing for user-facing Forge tasks
